text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "La Suisse et l’Union européenne disposent des mêmes exigences en matière d’efficacité énergétique pour ce qui est des aspirateurs.", "gist": "Switzerland and the EU have identical energy efficiency requirements for vacuum cleaners."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "900 watts", "gist": "Maximum power limit for vacuum cleaners is 900 watts."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "43 kWh par an", "gist": "Maximum average annual energy consumption for vacuum cleaners is 43 kWh."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L’étiquette-énergie pour les aspirateurs, appliquée durant une courte période, n’est plus valable.", "gist": "The energy label for vacuum cleaners, used for a short period, is no longer valid."}, {"type": "date", "quote": "18.01.2019", "gist": "Date of the European Court ruling."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Tribunal de l'Union européenne", "gist": "European Union Court"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "règlement européen n° 665/2013", "gist": "European regulation No. 665/2013"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "ordonnance sur les exigences relatives à l'efficacité énergétique (OEEE)", "gist": "Swiss ordinance on energy efficiency requirements (OEEE)"}]}
